goal: Define the minimum meanings needed to validate one candidate ontology edge against exact frozen Lean declaration evidence without granting semantic or admission authority.

concepts.meaning: An immutable tuple of repository, commit, path, blob, fully qualified declaration name, declaration kind, line number, and declaration-line digest that identifies one exact Lean declaration source.
A proposed directed relation with explicit source kind, predicate, target kind, and supporting Lean declaration bindings; it is evidence awaiting semantic review, not an admitted ontology relation.
The exact candidate edge, expected direction rule, selected source commit, and supporting declaration bindings presented for deterministic validation.
A deterministic result that records resolved source bindings, direction evaluation, rejection codes, input digest, and authority ceiling.
A passing validation result eligible for semantic-owner review; it is neither owner acceptance nor ontology admission.
The invariant that validation, compilation, or evidence emission cannot create definition, semantic, admission, implementation, publication, or execution authority.

open_questions: Which definitions-governance owner, if any, should promote these terms?
Which ontology semantic owner should decide whether a passing edge becomes an admitted relation?
claim_limit: Candidate meanings only; no canonical definition promotion or successor-stage acceptance.
